name: Priest
source:
The character you play as. 
A gentle and mature man.
His only wish is to help the troubled.
Even though he's fairly young, he's very dedicated to his duty.
[From [url=https://chanimk.itch.io/forgive-my-sins-father]itch.io[/url]]

A kind, gentle man who became a priest to help others and to escape from human desires, mainly the negativity that comes with being in love. Maybe he won't be so scared to love if he just finds the right person...
[From [url=https://chanimk.itch.io/forgive-my-desires-father]itch.io[/url]]
